$comment: Choghadiya: daytime (sunrise to sunset) and night (sunset to next sunrise) are each split into 8 equal parts. The 7 choghadiyas cycle in the order below. Day: start at the choghadiya ruled by the weekday lord, step +1. Night: start at (day start index + night_start_offset) mod 7, step night_step.
source: Standard choghadiya tables as published in North Indian panchangs.

review.note: Order, natures and the day/night stepping rules were entered from the commonly published tables; a vetted astrologer must confirm them.
